channel.title: Daily AI Feed - 2026-08-13
channel.description: A curated daily AI briefing with original-source links across practical prompts, engineering, product development, software development, under-the-radar signals, and fun experiments.

item.title: GhostSplice Isn't a Jailbreak, It's a Reminder That LLMs Can't Do Access Control
item.description: Article argues that the technique for bypassing access control is simply splitting a sentence; no new exploit primitive required, and it worked up to 100% of the time on some models. Why it matters: Direct: Demonstrates a simple, repeatable bypass via sentence-splitting, not a new exploit; highlights need for prompt-hardening and access-control validation.

item.title: AI is quietly turning HR meetings into court evidence
item.description: AI-generated meeting notes and prompts are increasingly discoverable in unfair dismissal cases, per Dentons employment partner. Why it matters: Direct: Signals AI-generated outputs can be used as legally discoverable material in disputes, prompting governance of AI-assisted notes.

item.title: alchemy-utils 0.1a0
item.description: Alchemy-utils 0.1a0 release introduces a database-agnostic version of sqlite-utils library and CLI; author mentions Codex and GPT-5 usage. Why it matters: Direct: Points to a database-agnostic tooling direction and hands-on use of AI helpers (Codex, GPT-5) to shape the project.

item.title: VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies
item.description: In enterprise settings, agents must reason across structured APIs and document collections, but current benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. Why it matters: Direct: Highlights a practical gap; enterprise-ready agents require cross-API/document retrieval reasoning beyond isolated benchmarks.

item.title: OpenAI Flags Rising Cyber Threat Capabilities, Tightens Model Safeguards
item.description: OpenAI cites rising cyber threat capabilities and outlines safeguards in response to advanced AI aiding offensive operations. Why it matters: Direct: Documents governance response to rising cyber capabilities and tightened safeguards.

item.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
item.description: Made by Google 2026 announced Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and Gemini features. Why it matters: Direct: Documents new hardware lineup and competing tracking device; Gemini features indicate AI integrations.

item.title: Stop being skeptical about AI for development with Charity Majors
item.description: Says skepticism about AI for development was rational in 2025 but not in 2026, featuring Charity Majors, Honeycomb CTO and co-founder. Why it matters: Direct: Signals product teams may accelerate AI adoption in development workflows.

item.title: Base Power Company: Chapter 3
item.description: Chapter 3 of Base Power Company, as discussed in Not Boring, centers on Manufacturing the Capability Cannon. Why it matters: Direct: Signals emphasis on scalable capability building for product teams.

item.title: I like that all AI commentators now need to pretend
item.description: Sparks skepticism about AI commentators claiming deep, nuanced expertise in hard math, highlighting inflated claims. Why it matters: Inference: Highlights risk of overclaiming AI capabilities in product contexts.

item.title: @BharatKChandar , @RuyuChen and I just released an updated version
item.description: Updated version of our paper 'Canaries in the Coal Mine?' finds no widespread AI-related job displacement yet, with earlier trends holding or growing. Why it matters: Direct: Reassures product teams about near-term risk; informs planning of AI bets and upskilling.

item.title: On Substack-Pangram Partnership: It's About Sending a Message
item.description: Comment on Substack-Pangram partnership highlighting false positives for a slop-free internet and expressing agreement. Why it matters: Direct: Highlights a stance on a 'slop-free internet' that teams may reflect when evaluating AI messaging and policy framing.

item.title: How to Use Surfer AI for Log File Analysis in 2026
item.description: Notes that Surfer AI for log file analysis works best with a cleaned, structured CSV export and a purpose-built prompt to surface anomalies, bot traps, and orphaned URLs. Why it matters: Direct: Suggests a concrete data format (cleaned CSV) and targeted prompt for operational log-analysis tasks.

item.title: Statewave's Memory Bundles Are Byte-Identical Every Time. Mem0 and Zep Can't Say That.
item.description: Describes how Mem0 or Zep deployments can yield two different answers to the same user question due to query-time retrieval over embeddings, highlighting ranking over lookup. Why it matters: Direct: Identifies a memory-retrieval pitfall where two deployments may return different results for identical prompts.

item.title: The Role Specialization Model (RSM): Coordinating LLM-Based Tools in Agentic Software Development - An Exploratory Case Study
item.description: Discusses Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0) where autonomous agents manage full development life cycles under human supervision. Why it matters: Direct: Describes a deployment paradigm for AI-enabled tooling in software development.

item.title: LLMs have the capacity for self-imposed steganography
item.description: This writeup demonstrates capacity for LLMs to take on steganography capabilities, with AI safety relevance for evading monitoring of a control protocol. Why it matters: Direct: Highlights a potential safety risk where LLMs could encode hidden information to bypass monitoring protocols.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (on OpenRouter)
item.description: The latest DeepSeek Pro model is now available, via API only, linked to OpenRouter because DeepSeek lacks an obvious announcement page. Why it matters: Direct: API-only availability and OpenRouter linkage may impact integration latency and discoverability of the new model.

item.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems (Anthropic, Frontier Red Team)
item.description: Anthropic research on agent coordination; Mythos 5 shows better coordination than previous models across several scenarios. Why it matters: Direct: Early signal that newer multiagent models may coordinate more effectively, informing risk assessments and governance.

item.title: Dyna Robotics Introduces Dyna-2: A World-Action Model Pre-Trained on 1 Million Hours of Human Video
item.description: Dyna-2 is a world-action model pre-trained on more than one million hours of egocentric human video; reports a scaling law on human data to 1M hours, transfer to unseen robot data, and evidence that video co-training drives cross-embodiment generalization. Why it matters: Direct: Demonstrated scaling laws with 1M hours of data, and cross-embodiment generalization via video co-training, impacting how robots learn from humans.

item.title: IF:CARGO: LLM-Based Semantic Compilation for Al-Native Rule Programming Games
item.description: IF:CARGO is an experimental puzzle game that uses a large language model as a semantic compiler; players author IF/THEN rules in natural language, and the model translates these into a constrained command schema for deterministic validation and execution by t... Why it matters: Direct: Demonstrates a game design workflow where natural-language rules are compiled into deterministic game commands via an LLM.

item.title: ‘I feel like I’m at war’: are we losing the battle against machine-made music?
item.description: The Guardian notes musicians' outcry as AI-generated music enters charts and labels scramble to adapt to a new normal where hits can be made quickly, fueling a complex debate. Why it matters: Direct: highlights the cultural and industry tensions around AI-generated music and the rapid adaptation by labels.

item.title: Set up your BizNode bot in under 5 minutes. The 14-step wizard auto-creates handles from your services list. Your bot goes...
item.description: BizNode is presented as an autonomous AI business operator that runs entirely on your machine, ensuring your data stays private and secure. Why it matters: Direct: Local operation and privacy are notable differentiators for AI business automation tools.
